important_methodology: Current rank and advancement benchmark are reconstructed only from attempts with point timestamps at or before the decision time.
2022 and 2024 are emitted for validation but prohibited from policy fitting.
Repeat attempts without explicit Lane1/Lane2 semantics remain REATTEMPT_SEMANTICS_UNRESOLVED.
No future final qualifying cutoff is substituted for the decision-time benchmark.
next_phase: Combine R4F1 Day1 interface with frozen R4LC5E-v2 Last Chance interface into the canonical Fused dataset.
